q: You need a sentiment label for 3 million product reviews stored in a Delta table, refreshed nightly. What is the most suitable approach?
o: A Python loop that sends each review to a serving endpoint with `requests`
An agent with a sentiment tool
`ai_analyze_sentiment(review)` in a scheduled SQL job that writes a table
Paste the reviews into the AI Playground in batches
e: A task-specific AI Function in SQL is built for batch enrichment: Databricks parallelizes the calls. Persisting the result in a table means each review is billed once.

q: An `ai_query` batch job over messy text fails completely because a few rows trigger model errors. Which change keeps the job running and records the failures?
o: Set `failOnError => false` and read `result` and `errorMessage` from the returned struct
Raise `max_tokens` in `modelParameters`
Wrap the query in a view
Remove `responseFormat`
e: With `failOnError => false`, `ai_query` returns a struct per row with the result or the error message, so one bad row does not fail the whole query.

q: Which AI Gateway feature writes the request and response payloads of a serving endpoint to a Delta table in Unity Catalog?
o: Rate limits
Inference tables (payload logging)
Traffic splitting
`system.serving.served_entities`
e: Inference tables log payloads to a UC Delta table for debugging, review and building evaluation sets. Token counts per requester come from usage tracking in `system.serving.endpoint_usage`.

q: A team wants to stop one heavy batch user from consuming all capacity and budget of a shared model endpoint. What should they configure?
o: A higher temperature for that user
A PII guardrail on the output
A new inference table
AI Gateway rate limits per user or per group
e: Rate limits cap queries or tokens per user, group or endpoint. Guardrails filter content, and inference tables only record what happened.

q: A keyword `CASE` baseline classifies tickets with 61% accuracy, and every miss is the label `other`. What is the best use of this result?
o: Discard it: rules are never useful once AI Functions exist
Use it to fine-tune the model
Use it as the score a model must beat, and send only the `other` rows to `ai_classify`
Replace the ground truth with the rule labels
e: A cheap baseline tells you what the model must improve on, and because matched rows are already correct, a cascade can call the model only for unmatched rows and save most of the cost.
